source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of incomplete dominance (PDF 90-91).

blocks.text: Incomplete dominance mein koi allele doosre par poori tarah dominant nahi hota, is liye heterozygote walidain ke darmiyan ka phenotype dikhata hai. Japani four-o'clock paudon mein surkh phool (RR) x safaid phool (WW) se sab heterozygous gulabi phool (RW) wale bachche bante hain, jis se pata chalta hai ke na surkh allele R aur na safaid allele W poori tarah dominant hai.

blocks.alt: Baen panel: surkh four-o'clock phool RR ko safaid WW se milane par gulabi RW phool; RW x RW ka 2 x 2 Punnett square RR, RW, RW aur WW deta hai, likha hai F2: 1 surkh : 2 gulabi : 1 safaid. Daen panel: teen red blood cells, pehle par sirf chokor M antigens (LM LM, M group), doosre par sirf tikoni N antigens (LN LN, N group) aur teesre par dono (LM LN, MN group).
blocks.caption: Four-o'clock phoolon mein incomplete dominance aur MN blood group mein co-dominance (Figure 18.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Incomplete dominance mein koi allele doosre ko nahi chhupata, is liye heterozygote darmiyani hota hai: surkh RR x safaid WW four-o'clock se sab gulabi RW, aur RW x RW se surkh, gulabi aur safaid 1:2:1 mein, jo genotype ki nisbat (ratio) jaisa hai. Co-dominance mein dono alleles poori tarah saath saath zahir hote hain: MN blood group mein allele LM M antigen aur LN N antigen banata hai, aur LM LN shakhs ke red cells par dono antigens hote hain, baghair kisi milawat ke.

blocks.text: Do gulabi paude (RW x RW) milane se surkh (RR), gulabi (RW) aur safaid (WW) 1:2:1 mein aate hain, yaani incomplete dominance mein phenotype ki nisbat genotype ki nisbat jaisi hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Gulabi four-o'clock (RW) ko surkh (RR) se milaya. (a) Surkh, (b) gulabi ka ehtimal, (c) gulabi aur surkh ki nisbat nikalein.
blocks.explanation: RR sirf R deta; RW R ya W barabar. (a) RR surkh = 1/2. (b) RW gulabi = 1/2. (c) Gulabi : surkh = 1 : 1.

items: RW x RW: 1 surkh : 2 gulabi : 1 safaid.
